notablePrerequisites: Ulasht has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Ulasht by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
Mazirek triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.
